newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU firms bid for nil value wheat licences.
newsitem.headline: EU firms bid for nil value wheat licences.

text.p: European grain firms bidding via France placed bids to export wheat grain under licences carrying a nil value refund, French grain officials said on Tuesday.
Exporters also bid through France to export wheat flour under licences carrying a five Ecus per tonne refund, they said.
Details on the volumes involved were not immediately available.

European grain industry sources said earlier they were waiting to see whether the European Union would reduce its standing refund for wheat flour exports in the wake of Monday's abolition of a zero refund for wheat grain exports.
The flour refund currently stands at five Ecus per tonne.
On Monday the EU scrapped a zero refund for soft wheat and durum wheat exports, replacing it with a nil value entry.
The entry cannot be set in advance and has no monthly increments.
